about: What bites in Prismheart's fresh water (Windmere's pond). Original species. Each fish is also an item: eat it from ITEM for its effect. weight = how often it bites (relative); window_s = how long the bite lasts before it gets away, in game seconds. night_weight (optional) replaces weight between dusk and dawn: the rare fish feed at night.

fish.name: Reedling
fish.note: a thin silver fish that lives in the reed beds

fish.name: Pond Perch
fish.note: striped green and gold, always hungry

fish.name: Mudskipper Eel
fish.note: it wriggles back toward the bank

fish.name: Glassfin Minnow
fish.note: fins clear as window glass; mages chew them

fish.name: Sunscale Carp
fish.note: warm to the touch even at night

fish.name: Prismscale Koi
fish.note: its scales split light like the Prism Heart
